generatorContract.caseOrdering: payload declaration order, strategy declaration order, persistence order, ascending size, parallel-call order. Within each strategy assign normal cases to entry points round-robin in declared entry-point order; failures and budgets use fixture, strategy, entry-point declaration order
generatorContract.jsonWrapping: For payload kind json, wrap the expanded UTF-8 string with Python json.dumps ensure_ascii=False and separators comma/colon; all other kinds use the expanded bytes unchanged. Raw byte counts precede wrapping.
generatorContract.payloadExpansion: Target zero is empty. Otherwise repeat the complete UTF-8 base byte sequence, then fill the remainder with ASCII '~'; never split a code point. An empty base uses only '~'. No separator is inserted.

longHistory.indexSemantics: zero-based prose index; protected records are inserted immediately before prose records 10 and 900
